conflicts.fact: Wording of the DQB question about the temperature-rate relationship
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 DQB asks 'Why does the rate roughly double for each 15 C rise?'. The table (10 C = 3.7, 25 C = 9.1, 40 C = 19.2, 55 C = 38.5) shows an increase of about 2.5x from 10 C to 25 C, then about 2.1x for each later 15 C step, so 'roughly double' is slightly inaccurate for the first step. It does not contradict the sequence.
